## Summary

What changed, and what user or contributor need does it address?

## Compatibility

Note any API, peer-dependency, wire-contract, visual, or accessibility impact.

## Verification

List the commands and manual checks you ran. If you skipped a check, explain why.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover behavior changes, or no test change is needed
- [ ] Fairtrade-owned adapters, view models, and canonical visuals were not forked
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed
